name: wsl-web-shell
description: Standalone Windows Electron shell for WebUIs served by native WSL2 distributions
author: triagmas

scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test && npm run build && npm run docs:check
scripts.dist:dir: npm run build && electron-builder --win dir --x64 --publish never
scripts.dist:portable: npm run build && electron-builder --win portable --x64 --publish never
scripts.dist:setup: npm run build && electron-builder --win nsis --x64 --publish never
scripts.screenshots: npm run build && xvfb-run -a electron scripts/screenshot-ui.cjs --no-sandbox --write-images
scripts.chrome:smoke: npm run build && xvfb-run -a electron scripts/screenshot-ui.cjs --no-sandbox
scripts.composition:smoke: npm run build && npm run composition:build && xvfb-run -a electron scripts/composition-smoke.cjs --no-sandbox
scripts.paint:probe: npm run build && npm run composition:build && electron scripts/paint-probe.cjs
scripts.paint:probe:xvfb: npm run build && npm run composition:build && xvfb-run -a electron scripts/paint-probe.cjs --no-sandbox
